operations.summary: Read interval node traffic, not cumulative lifetime counters
operations.description: Requires nodes.read or platform.admin in a platform scope. external_only differences each NIC before selecting the current sample's default-route devices. A route change therefore cannot create a lifetime-counter spike. At least two known snapshots with a baseline for each selected NIC are required. Missing evidence is not a zero. Explicitly excluded NICs are omitted after automatic selection. This is monitoring, not billable usage.

params.name: external_only
params.description: Literal true or false, at most once. Default false preserves old API callers. The management UI explicitly sends true by default. Filters bandwidth/traffic by each sample's reported network_selection; missing or unavailable selection never means all interfaces. Other metric types are unchanged. False exposes all original NIC facts for manual diagnostics.

params.name: start
params.description: Start of a window no longer than 31 days; defaults to one hour ago for realtime and one day ago for traffic.

params.name: end
params.description: Defaults to now; must not precede start.

params.name: excl_nic
params.description: Space-separated interface names to exclude. excluded_nic is a compatible alias; both sets are combined.

responses.description: Interval bytes at each sample time, without billing settlement claims.
Platform scope and nodes.read or platform.admin required.
